fields.label: Name des Kindes
fields.hint: Steht groß und bunt auf dem Shirt.

prompt:
Cheerful, friendly kids' T-shirt illustration, portrait, isolated on a plain empty background.

A big, cute, kind-eyed cartoon of a "{tier}" as the main motif (pose as in the variation below), rounded shapes, happy expression, child-friendly and never scary.
The child's name is the hero of the design and reads exactly "{kindname}" in large, playful, bouncy hand-lettering.
[[A small round badge shows exactly "{alter}".]]

Style: bright cheerful flat illustration, bold clean outlines, happy saturated colors, a few little stars or hearts as accents, storybook feel, no photorealism, no background scene.
